name: Conflict Taxonomy
description: Catalog conflict types: concurrent edits, delete-recreate, move-edit, rename-delete. Each has a documented resolution strategy.
purpose: Systematically catalog every conflict type the system can encounter and prescribe a deterministic resolution strategy for each, ensuring no conflict is handled ad-hoc.
acceptanceCriteria: All conflict types (concurrent edits, delete-recreate, move-edit, rename-delete, and others) are cataloged.
Each conflict type has a documented deterministic resolution strategy.
Resolution strategies are expressed as code, not just documentation.
Conflict detection is automatic at sync time.
Unresolvable conflicts are surfaced to the user with clear guidance.
